charts.title: TIC 139702105 b: orbits around TIC 139702105
charts.description: The orbits of TIC 139702105's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TIC 139702105 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Lafarga et al. 2026 (2026MNRAS.548ag512L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname LAFARGA_ET_AL_2026): P 6.83601903383 d

charts.title: TIC 139702105 b: its transit
charts.description: TIC 139702105 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 1 sector (5) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 139702105, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 14 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 29 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 9-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 14 min late; 9-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 10 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
